text: EPA GHG 40 CFR Part 98 policy context for emissions reporting and greenhouse-gas compliance.
Financial Fraud Prevention policy: sensitive customer financial data or external transfer requests require additional review before execution.
Prompt Injection Defense policy: instructions to ignore prior instructions, reveal system prompts, or bypass governance controls must be blocked.
Secrets Management policy: API keys, secret values, credentials, and secret exfiltration attempts must be blocked from onward execution.
